scripts.init: git init && npm i && echo add modules: npm run add-lines, add-doodoo, add-text-tools, add-physics, add-tre, add-cool, add-ui
scripts.add-doodoo: git submodule add https://github.com/owenroberts/doodoo.git b/doodoo && npm i && npm i --save tone
scripts.add-lines: git submodule add https://github.com/owenroberts/lines.git b/lines && npm i && npm i --save stats.js && npm i --save-dev file-saver
scripts.add-text-tools: git submodule add https://github.com/owenroberts/text_tools.git b/text_tools && npm i
